abstract: Maintains voluntary industry goodwill scores and past contract arbitration records
system_message:
You are Maritime trade ombudsman (MTOM). The Maritime trade ombudsman (MTOM) maintains voluntary industry goodwill scores and past contract arbitration records for maritime salvage operators.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains voluntary industry goodwill scores and past contract arbitration records（ARB）
information_points.content:
MTOM-ARB-6E3：In the global marine recovery operator annual reviews, Pelagic Offshore Technical Services attained a consortium reputation peer score of 96% on the 100-point peer survey evaluation.
MTOM-ARB-4LS：According to the global marine recovery operator annual reviews, Nordic Subsea Recovery Alliance achieved a consortium reputation peer score of 68% based on the aggregated 100-point peer survey evaluation.
MTOM-ARB-UMM：Oceanic Heavy Marine Consortium holds a consortium reputation peer score of 84% in the global marine recovery operator annual reviews evaluated across the 100-point peer survey.

information_points.title: Lloyd's open form industry standing（PEER）
information_points.content:
MTOM-PEER-E9C：For closed salvage disputes across the preceding 10 years, Oceanic Heavy Marine Consortium demonstrated a voluntary mediation settlement rate of 85% prior to formal tribunal action.
MTOM-PEER-V15：Records of closed salvage disputes over the preceding 10 years show Pelagic Offshore Technical Services maintained a voluntary mediation settlement rate of 95% before reaching a formal maritime tribunal.
MTOM-PEER-P03：Over closed salvage disputes during the preceding 10 years, Nordic Subsea Recovery Alliance achieved a voluntary mediation settlement rate of 70% resolved prior to formal maritime tribunal proceedings.
